title: US returns to two-carrier presence in West Asia as George Washington exits
description:
The US military has gone back to having two aircraft carriers supporting Iran war operations after the USS George Washington departed the Middle East.
A spokesperson for the US Pacific Fleet, Cmdr Katie Koenig, said on Wednesday that the Japan-based USS George Washington was now under its control and "conducting routine operations" in the Asia-Pacific region.
The development is the latest in a shuffling of aircraft carriers in the Middle East. During the Iran war, the carriers have served as the linchpin of a US flotilla that has blockaded all merchant shipping to and from the Islamic Republic as the Trump administration looks to keep squeezing Tehran's economy by preventing its oil from reaching global markets.
The George Washington departed the Middle East in the same week that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived, briefly bringing the number of carriers in the waters off Iran to the unusually high amount of three.
